newsitem.title: ESTONIA: KALEV PLEASED WITH FIRST QUARTER.
newsitem.headline: KALEV PLEASED WITH FIRST QUARTER.

text.p: Estonia's largest confectionary company Kalev said on Monday that it was happy with its first quarter profit of 13 million kroons, which compared with a profit of 2.2 million kroons in the same period as last year.
"We think that the first quarter was successful...as 44 percent of the yearly profit estimate has been fulfilled," Andrus Koha, finance director, told Reuters.
Sales of real estate formed a large part of the first quarter profit, Koha said.
Kalev sold some old warehouses in Tallinn and its former caramel factory.
Koha said he could not comment on a possible revision of the year profit estimate of up to 30 million kroons.
